extracted.name: CHICKEN WINGS 😋😋😋
instruction_lines: Marinate chicken with salt, vinegar, red chilli powder, black pepper powder and ginger garlic paste.. set aside for 30 minutes..
For coating add all purpose flour, corn flour, salt, red chilli powder, black pepper powder, and mix well.. beat one egg
1st coat with dry ingredients then egg and again with dry ingredients...
You can fry them or bake.. I just baked on 180•C for 20 minute each side. Brush with oil on baking tray before baking. And enjoy 😊
